💡 freecad-mcp | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enable users to design and manipulate 3D models within FreeCAD using natural language commands processed by Claude AI.
✨ Key Features: • FreeCAD MCP server integration • Control FreeCAD from Claude Desktop • Generate 3D models via AI conversation • Supports designing from 2D drawings • Addon installation for FreeCAD
📖 Summary: This repository provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that integrates FreeCAD with Claude Desktop, enabling users to control FreeCAD functionalities and generate 3D models through conversational AI.
